title: Build ContextPage with context inspector and JSON viewer
description:
ContextPage.tsx is a complete stub (`
Context Inspector
`). Build a context data inspector. **Implementation:** - Input field to enter a job ID or context pointer - Fetch context data using `GET /api/v1/memory?ptr=` (same endpoint used in JobDetailPage payload section) - Display context as a collapsible JSON tree viewer - Add "Copy JSON" button for clipboard export - Add search within context (Ctrl+F style filter on keys/values) - Show metadata: pointer key, size, TTL if available **Files:** `dashboard/src/pages/ContextPage.tsx`
definitionOfDone: Context inspector accepts job ID or pointer input
Fetches and displays context data as formatted JSON

implementationPlan.description: Rewrite dashboard/src/pages/ContextPage.tsx: (1) Input field for job ID or context pointer (Input component). (2) Fetch button triggers GET /api/v1/memory?ptr=<value> via get() from api/client. (3) Display result as formatted JSON in a pre block with syntax highlighting (alternating key/value colors via spans). (4) Copy JSON button using navigator.clipboard.writeText(). (5) Search/filter input that highlights matching keys/values. (6) Metadata display: pointer key, approximate size (JSON.stringify length). (7) Loading spinner, error message, empty state ('Enter a job ID or context pointer above').
implementationPlan.note: Rewrote ContextPage from stub. Input for job ID/pointer, Fetch button, GET /api/v1/memory?ptr=, JSON viewer with line-level filter highlighting, Copy JSON button, metadata (pointer, size). Loading/error/empty states.
